Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy

In a large bowl, combine the butter and caster sugar until creamy. Add the egg and a pinch of salt. 2) Stir into a buttery mixture. Add the sifted flour. 3) Whisk well. You should end up with a smooth dough. Cover it with a piece of plastic wrap and put the dough in the fridge for 15 minutes to chill and set. Incorporate 1 1/8 cup plain flour, 12 tbsp unsalted butter, 5 2/3 tbsp caster sugar, and 1 pc egg smoothly until evenly distributed.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

2

Shape & Press Dough Evenly

In the meantime combine the cassonade (or brown sugar) and the cinnamon. 5) Transfer the dough onto a floured surface and knead it for a minute. Add extra flour if necessary. Roll the dough out gently into a nice rectangle. It should be about ⅕-inch (5 mm) thick. Sprinkle with the sugary cinnamon mixture. 6) Carefully start rolling the dough up. If it is too sticky, put it in the fridge again for a couple of minutes. Wrap it up tightly in plastic wrap. Incorporate 1 pinch salt, 2 tsp ground cinnamon, and 1 1/8 oz brown sugar smoothly until evenly distributed.

3

Bake Cinnamon Roll Cookies & Check Doneness

Bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

4

Shape & Press Dough Evenly

Put it in the fridge for 30 minutes to chill and set. After that, remove the cling film and cut the dough roll into even slices. 8) Place the slices on a baking paper lined baking tray. Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 356°F (180°C) for 14 to 16 minutes. 9) Let the baked cinnamon roll cookies cool down fully before eating or wrapping them up.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ac_unit

Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES213 kcal
SERVINGS12
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep cinnamon roll cookies in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
